rapport_notes: Warm, funny ("you're very strong"), patient with a rambling customer, gracious about the abrupt decline.

evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No substantive concern was raised; the heavy-planters and heavy-TV-stand comments were resolved by the customer herself with banter, not something requiring deeper digging.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: Call ended on the price/transportation-fee objection before Stage 3 differentiators or estimate range were reached.

top_strength: Handled a firm, rambly customer with patience and humor, giving a fully transparent pricing walkthrough right up to the moment she declined.
coaching_note: Never got to the personalized time estimate or Save Your Ass lines before she priced out on the transportation fee -- surfacing the ballpark total earlier might have left room to reframe value before the sticker shock hit.
